articles.summary: IonQ's research leverages movable qubits and sparse cyclic layouts to build fault-tolerant, efficient, and modular quantum computing systems, a crucial step towards larger and more powerful quantum computers.
articles.title: Reimagining Error Correction for Modular Quantum Computing

articles.summary: Read IonQ's analysis of logical qubits and fault tolerant quantum computing (FTQC). Understand the industry's defining challenge, why physical qubit quality is paramount, and IonQ's strategic foundation for scalable, error-corrected quantum computing.
articles.title: Demystifying Logical Qubits and Fault Tolerance
